task: Acquire real-world data to resolve the RC2 data bottleneck (independent normal vs failing streams)

independence_rules: adjacent clips from one print do not count as independent
a failing print's pre-failure segment does not count as an independent normal stream
static images never count as evidence of video-level false-alarm rates

sources_evaluated.name: EmptyDeck — Bed-Adhesion Failure-Onset Dataset for FDM 3D Printing
sources_evaluated.license_verification: Repo README states CC BY-NC 4.0 for annotations/masks/metadata; videos 'provided for research use under the same terms'. GitHub API license field is null (not authoritative).
sources_evaluated.annotation_format: per-sequence change point (onset_frame); ground-truth masks in [0,onset)
sources_evaluated.collection_methodology: Bed-mounted camera timelapses of FDM prints; onset of bed-adhesion failure annotated by frame index.
known_limitations: All failures are bed-adhesion (single failure type)
normal baseline is the same print's pre-onset segment -> NOT independent normal
sources_evaluated.intended_usage: research-only independent failing streams; never in a release/training split

sources_evaluated.name: FDM-3D-Printing-Defect-Dataset (wengmhu)
sources_evaluated.license_verification: LICENSE file in the GitHub repository (MIT).
sources_evaluated.annotation_format: image classification by folder (single class per image)
sources_evaluated.resolution: not stated; raw photos ~3.3 MB each
sources_evaluated.collection_methodology: FFF/FDM printer defect photos (per accompanying paper).
known_limitations: static images only (no video -> no FAR evidence)
sources_evaluated.intended_usage: supplemental training / exploratory failure-type coverage only

sources_evaluated.name: Trier FFF-QC v2 — Quality Control in Additive Manufacturing
sources_evaluated.source: Zenodo record 18628777 (Trier University of Applied Sciences)

sources_evaluated.name: Caxton (University of Cambridge)
sources_evaluated.annotation_format: continuous process parameters (flow, lateral speed, Z offset, hotend/bed temp, timestamps, nozzle x/y) + anomaly status
sources_evaluated.collection_methodology: automated fleet of 8 extrusion printers; 192 parts
known_limitations: repository hosts only CSVs (~110-144 MB); images hosted elsewhere
sources_evaluated.blocked_reason: no failure labels; images not hosted in the repository

sources_evaluated.name: 3d-printing-errors (Roboflow Universe)
sources_evaluated.license_verification: Dataset page license field (community dataset; underlying-image provenance caution).
sources_evaluated.blocked_reason: download requires Roboflow account/API key (HTTP 403 anonymous)

sources_evaluated.name: Early detection of 3D printing issues (Kaggle competition)
sources_evaluated.license_verification: Governed by competition rules; requires account + rule acceptance to view/download.
sources_evaluated.image_count_unit: 7 printers, 6-20 prints each, print = series of snapshots
sources_evaluated.intended_usage: highest-value untapped external source (candidate independent environments)
sources_evaluated.blocked_reason: no Kaggle credentials / competition rules not accepted

wengmhu_subset.note: bulk 6.29 GB zip deleted after extracting the subset

trier_staged.note: already staged in-repo; reused, not re-downloaded

validation.human_verification_note: agent has no vision; labels are the dataset's weak video-level labels + published onset_frame

gap_assessment.reason: no accessible source provides independent normal multi-frame streams; pre-onset baselines are non-independent; other sources are static or blocked

single_highest_value_next_action.action: Accept the Kaggle 'early-detection-of-3d-printing-issues' competition rules and download its data; verify normal-print presence and its actual licence.
single_highest_value_next_action.rationale: only remaining external source plausibly containing many independent snapshot-sequences (7 printers x 6-20 prints) in a distinct camera domain
single_highest_value_next_action.fallback: own collection: one fixed camera, >=16 normal prints + >=4 induced failures on a target printer

acquired_data.notes: Under-extrusion only; nozzle camera; leakage-safe by print.
